title: He Knew Everything… So Why the Spilled Tea? 🍵 | A Zen Fable, Sung
tiktok_title: He knew everything. So the master kept pouring.
caption:
He had read every book… so why did the old master keep pouring until the tea ran over? 🍵 A Zen story about the one thing a full mind cannot do: learn.

#talesinink #moralstories #fable #ukiyoe #shorts #zen #wisdom #storytime
moral: Empty your cup, and let the world pour in.
